# Vocalxlabs: AI-first for Follow Up Boss

> Vocalxlabs audits and rebuilds the Follow Up Boss account a real estate team already runs, then installs AI that works every lead every day. The distinguishing layer is intent: behaviour on the team's own search site decides who gets called first, so agents start the day on the leads who are actually ready. Positioning is "same agents, same leads, more closings". Every engagement starts with a free CRM audit.

## What it is
- A one-time build inside the client's own Follow Up Boss account, delivered in four layers: Foundation (stages, lead flows, smart lists, routing, action plans), Signal (Follow Up Boss Pixel, listings opened, repeat views, recency, saved searches, intent scoring), Conversation (AI texting and calling, qualification, listing match, appointment booking, full write-back), and Visibility (a weekly per-agent scoreboard by email).
- Nothing new for agents to open. Everything appears on the Follow Up Boss person record and in the smart lists they already call from, so there is no rollout and no second dashboard.
- Live in about fifteen days. Acceptance tested against a written script on test contacts before any real lead is in scope. First 90 days of managed operations included.

## Who it is for
- US real estate teams and brokerages running Follow Up Boss as the system of record, usually 2,000 or more contacts and real monthly lead spend, often with agents producing at very different levels.
- Not a fit for solo agents early on, for anyone whose problem is lead volume rather than lead handling, or for anyone shopping on price.

## The offer
- Free Follow Up Boss audit: 45 minutes inside the account, covering the CRM, the workflow and the process. The client receives a written report ranking where closings are being lost and what it is costing them, and keeps it whether or not they hire Vocalxlabs.
- Pricing is set after the audit, not before. It is a one-time build. There is no per-reply charge and no monthly platform fee, because there is no platform.

## Key facts
- The intent layer reads behaviour on the client's own search site through the Follow Up Boss Pixel: which listings a lead opens, how often, how recently, and what they search for. Browsing on third-party portals such as Zillow or Realtor.com is not visible and Vocalxlabs does not claim otherwise.
- The client owns the build. Accounts, phone numbers, keys, data and documentation are in their name from day one, and everything keeps running if the relationship ends.
- Carrier registration, opt-out handling and a timestamped audit trail are part of every build.
- Reference build: Prime Realty Partners, broker Timothy Bowen, 8 agents across 3 South Jersey territories, 3,272 contacts. First message out 2.4 seconds after a lead lands, eleven acceptance scenarios signed off before a real lead was in scope, zero write-back failures across the run.
- Vocalxlabs is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or a reseller of Follow Up Boss or Zillow Group.
